name: Qwilr
tagline: Qwilr turns sales proposals into interactive, web-based pages with embedded pricing calculators, video, and e-signatures. Its AI writing assistant generates proposal content from deal notes and templates, while analytics show exactly which sections prospects viewed and for how long.
